headline: Apple schedules 'Pro and Tell' event expected to unveil touchscreen Mac
summary: Apple has scheduled a 'Pro and Tell' product event for October 28th at 1PM ET in Los Angeles, expected to introduce the first touchscreen Mac, a new MacBook Pro with an OLED display, and an updated iPad mini. Outlets differ on how specific that iPad mini update is, with one describing it only as refreshed and another specifying an OLED display.
